question: is there a legal GND barrel site for U21.4 anywhere in 58.0-60.1 x 38.0-40.8 mm, at any barrel size
board: w/d716/cellr4 -- D-714's cell without the spine, with /ACC_5V_LX routed at 0.600 mm
method: exact analytic clearance: segment/point distance to every non-GND track, via and rectangular pad on the board; 0.200 mm clearance, 0.300 mm where the neighbour is a SWITCH_NODE TRACK
finding: NONE USABLE.  The best site is (58.900, 38.000) and it is SHORT AT EVERY MANUFACTURABLE SIZE -- 0.1373 mm at 0.600, 0.0623 at 0.450 and 0.0123 mm at 0.350, the smallest barrel this board's own section-12 pad-escape relief grants.  A 0.250 mm barrel clears by +0.0377 mm but is below every via floor on this board and could not carry a converter's ground return in any case.  And even the 0.350 site cannot be REACHED: a 0.250 mm stub from U21.4's land to it clears /ACC_5V_LX by 0.101 mm against the 0.300 mm SWITCH_NODE routed clearance.
